# Lists and quotes

[← Back to the index](quickstart.md)

## Bullets

- Dash bullet
* Star bullet
+ Plus bullet
- Bullet with **bold**, *italic*, `code` and a [link](01-text.md)
- A long bullet that wraps onto several lines so you can see how the continuation lines line up with the
  first line of text, both in preview and in the editor, as the window narrows

## Numbers

1. First
2. Second
3. Third
10. Ten (two digits)
100. A hundred (three digits)
1) Parenthesis style
2) Second, parenthesis style

## Nesting

- Level 1
  - Level 2
    - Level 3
      - Level 4
  - Back to level 2
1. Numbered parent
   - Bullet child
     1. Numbered grandchild
     2. Another grandchild
2. Second parent

## Task lists

- [ ] Unchecked task
- [x] Checked task
- [X] Checked with a capital X
- [ ] Task with **bold** and a [link](02-tables.md)
  - [ ] Nested subtask
  - [x] Done subtask

## Block quotes

> A single-line quote.

> A longer quote that wraps across multiple lines. It should be indented and slightly muted in
> preview, and the `>` markers should be hidden there but dimmed in the editor.
>
> A second paragraph inside the same quote, with **bold** and *italic*.

> Outer quote
> > Nested quote
> > > Doubly nested

> - A list inside a quote
> - Second item

## Not lists

-Not a bullet (no space after the dash)

1.Not numbered (no space after the dot)

2024. That line starts with a year followed by a period, which Markdown does treat as a list.
